text_block_list.text:
Passing behind the school building in the 
evening, I spotted an uncharacteristically 
quiet Marvelous Sunday.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Marvelouuus...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Oh my? Marvelous-san, whatever are you 
doing over there?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
The flowers that were blooming here... 
when I looked just now, they had withered 
away.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: And it was such a pretty flower, too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Ah... I see.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
However... do you know about perennial 
plants, Marvelous-san?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Nope, I had no idea! Tell me, tell 
me, Ardan☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Even if its petals fall and the parts 
above ground, like the leaves and stems, 
wither away—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
The roots of perennial plants live on 
underground. And that is how they bloom 
again the following year.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Waaaah...!! So, so amazing~!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yes. So I'm sure it will bloom with 
beautiful flowers again around this time 
next year.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Perennials! Got it, memorized!! That's 
super-duper marvelous☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Yes, it is marvelous.

I made eye contact with Marvelous Sunday, 
who was frolicking energetically.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe☆ Perennials are just so marvelous, 
aren't they?★
choice_data_list:
Mejiro Ardan sure knows a lot, doesn't 
she?

I wonder why perennials have to wither 
once before they grow again?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Fufu, thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I once became curious about how they bloom 
again the following year even after 
withering, so I looked into it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"I thought it was wonderful how it blooms 
so powerfully, as if refusing to ever give 
up."

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
You're so right☆ Truly marvelous★ I wanna 
be just like a perennial too☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
That's wonderful. I'd like to follow that 
example myself.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Yup☆ Let's be marvelous together★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: True! Why is that?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"Just as animals hibernate, they spend the 
unfavorable seasons underground."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps she is building up her strength... 
in preparation for the moment she shines 
the brightest.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Living earnestly within the limited time 
given and shining with all one's might. I 
want to live like that, too.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"Me too, me too☆ Let's be marvelous 
together★"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Yes. Let's do our best.
